quality_gates.gate: GATE 1 — Pure Domain Logic Decoupling Gate
quality_gates.evidence: CoreReconciliationEngine has 0 framework imports, 0 network I/O, completely pure deterministic math functions.

quality_gates.gate: GATE 2 — Mathematical Proration & Landed Cost Gate
quality_gates.evidence: Weight proration for freight, FOB proration for insurance and local expenses, Ad-Valorem, IGV, IPM, and perception correctly computed.

quality_gates.gate: GATE 3 — Traffic Light Severity Tri-Color Gate
quality_gates.evidence: Green (<= $0.01), Yellow (<= $10.00), Red (> $10.00 or HS Code mismatch) reliably tagged on every item.

quality_gates.gate: GATE 4 — Cryptographic SHA-256 Audit Trail Gate
quality_gates.evidence: SHA-256 audit hash calculated over dossier summary and items on every reconciliation run.
